panels.title: Run success rate, 7d (SLO 95%)
panels.description: Share of finished runs that succeeded over the last 7 days, per job.

panels.title: Oldest asset, minutes (SLO 120)
panels.description: Minutes since the least recently refreshed asset was materialized.

panels.title: Asset checks passing
panels.description: Share of asset checks (dbt tests) passing on their latest run.

panels.title: Asset age, minutes
panels.description: Minutes since each asset was last materialized. Drops to zero on every refresh.

panels.title: Ever materialized
panels.description: 1 if the asset has been materialized at least once, else 0.

panels.title: Row count
panels.description: Rows at each asset's last materialization (only assets that report dagster/row_count).

panels.title: Row count change, last 1h
panels.description: Difference in row count versus one hour ago. Sudden drops can mean missing data.

panels.title: Failing checks per asset
panels.description: Number of asset checks (dbt tests) failing on their latest run, per asset.

panels.title: Last run result
panels.description: 1 if the job's latest finished run succeeded, 0 if it failed.

panels.title: Run duration
panels.description: Wall-clock time of each finished run.
